Date: July 2,2014 Address: 129 Front Street, County: New York Block: 037 Lots: 13 Address: 110 Wall Street County: New York Block: 037 Lot: 8 RECORDANDRETURNTO: Goldfarb &Fleece LLP 345ParkAvenue NewYork,NY10154 Attn: Robert M. ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the ? day of July 2014, by and among 129 Front Hotel LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 129 Front Street, New York, New York 10005 (hereinafter referred to as "Owner") and 110 Wall Street L.P., having an address at c/o Rudin Management Co.,Inc.,345Park Avenue,NewYork,NewYork 10154 (hereinafter referred to as"Developer"), (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereafter collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain vacant land,with the building and improvements thereon,located in theBorough of Manhattan,County of NewYorkand City and State of NewYork,known as Lot 13 in Block 037on theTax Map of the City of NewYork, and as and by the street address 129 Front Street, New York, New York,and more particularly located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future is herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the "OwnerParcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land located in the Borough of Manhattan, County of NewYork, City and State of NewYork, known as Lot 8 in Block 037 on the Tax Map oftheCity ofNewYork,and as and by the street address 110 WallStreet,NewYork, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the“Developer Land"); WHEREAS, the Developer Land is currently improved with a building that Developer may wish to expand or replace with a larger building in the future (such building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS,the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution if the Owner Parcel were a single zoning lot, so that the Transferable Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the DeveloperParcel; WHEREAS, the Developer Building,if expanded or replaced,will contain more floor area (as hereinafter defined) than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution if the DeveloperParcel were a single zoning lot and the Parties therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution to merge the Owner Owner to convey and make available the Transferable Development Rights for utilization in 00305460.2 1
